summary: Karyopharm Therapeutics filed an 8-K Item 8.01 announcement on July 30, 2026. The filing reports Phase 3 XPORT-EC-042 topline data showing selinexor failed to meet the primary endpoint of progression-free survival in TP53 wild-type endometrial cancer, with a trend favoring the treatment arm (HR=0.76; p=0.0791). It also discloses plans to submit an sNDA in August 2026 for accelerated approval of selinexor plus ruxolitinib in myelofibrosis. This is a routine clinical development update, not a special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or shareholder event.
